title: Decay From Whole
subtitle: A modelled account of attention, calm, agency and time under a feedback-ranked feed, with its mapping stated
premise: We model four dimensions of a person as states that start whole and wear down under the recorded events of a feed session, with a stated mapping from events to decrements, and ask how the trajectory depends on the pace of the feed and on the way it is used. The model is a figure for a mechanism, not a measurement of a person, and every claim below is a claim about the model.
claim: In the model, attention falls with arrivals and taps and recovers only in quiet; calm follows a pulse the feed sets on a bad day regardless of the user's hands; agency wears under the user's own echo and does not return when the echo ages out; and the minutes meant for something else drain and never return. The pace of the feed, not the user's behaviour, is the largest single factor on a bad day.
applicability: The mapping from events to decrements is explicit and tunable, so the model can be fitted against measured data rather than asserted.
The conformance bench between the interactive piece and the simulator is a template for keeping an instrument and its model in agreement.
The extremes in the sample are real, re-runnable sessions, which makes case study possible alongside the aggregate.
tone: careful; every number carries its spread; the model is named as a model in every section
